text:
ava: quick concept drop 1 - Role Templates. idea: admins can save a permission set as a template (e.g., "Data Analyst Lite") then apply it when creating or editing roles. reduces repetitive toggling in invite flows.

sam: metrics question 1 what would success look like? fewer clicks on average per role create? fewer support tickets about misconfigured grants?

ava: both. primary: lower mean time-to-create and less role churn. also track template reuse rate and # of manual edits after apply.

mohit: audit implications: applying a template should create a single audit entry summarizing the template applied + a compact diff of actual permission changes. we must avoid spamming the audit with a separate line per permission.

tess: accessibility: applying a template must be reversible via keyboard (undo toast) and we need clear SR announcements. sample SR pattern suggestion:

  role="listitem" aria-label="Data Analyst Lite 1 8 members 1 template: Data Analyst Lite applied"

and toast SR announce: "Template 'Data Analyst Lite' applied to Role X. Press U to undo."

kevin-designbot: uploaded mock: https://figma.redwood/templates/tiles shows 3 template tiles in the role create drawer, plus a compact keyboard-first picker. also variants for templates-with-SSO-flag (read-only) and template-badge on roles.

ava: SSO detail: product only enforces org-level SSO. templates can be annotated with a read-only SSO note (e.g., "Requires org SSO") but must not toggle SSO per-role. the template UI should surface that as a non-interactive tag.

mohit: audit record for template apply should be: actor, template-name, role-id, summary-diff (n added, m removed), and a link to expanded diff. minimal noise in timeline but full diff available on click.

invite-bot: FYI we also want this to feed the bulk-invite modal. when pasting emails, allow selecting a template to apply to all invites in that batch. keyboard flow: Paste -> Tab -> Template Picker -> Enter -> Invite.

tess: keyboard & SR notes for bulk-invite modal: make the paste area role="textbox" aria-multiline="true" with instructions in aria-describedby. after parsing show a table with email + role (template name) and an accessible inline edit per row. keyboard should allow arrow navigation and Enter to edit role cell.

ava: small JS pattern for focus-return on open/close panels (for devs):

  ```js
  const prev = document.activeElement;
  openPanel().then(() => panel.querySelector('[data-first]').focus());
  closePanel(() => prev && prev.focus());
  ```

kevin-designbot: microcopy suggestion for template badge tooltip: "Template applied: Data Analyst Lite. See audit for exact changes." short alt: "Applied template: Data Analyst Lite."

sam: product checklist: 1) templates are meta-ui only (no per-role SSO enforcement) 2) audit summarization required 3) bulk-invite integration 4) keyboard undo + SR toasts.

ava: action items: kevin 1 add template tiles + badge variants to figma and include disabled-SSO callout; mohit 1 design audit summary format & link to expanded diff; tess 1 write SR strings for template apply/undo + bulk-invite parsing flow; sam 1 confirm product ok to proceed with non-SSO templates. sync Mon 10:30 in design crit. :shipit:
